subject: Ziggy names the black-coat character James, Lisan al-Gaib's brother
body:
Ziggy explicitly adopts the man in HD-RETURN-957897bd45c4 / HIP-COAT-01_v001.jpg as James, Lisan al-Gaib's brother. Remove the gun and preserve this exact man, facial appearance, circular astrolabe chest tattoo and other tattoos, long black coat, layered chains, pose, framing, lighting and hangar/ship scene. This is a new Lisan cast use of a Hon-origin source, not approval of this image as Dolo.

CFA SITE INDEX inspected the original and matched it to the annotated screenshot. Use this exact gun-variant source, NOT its earlier parent HD-DROP-45892924b234, which has a different tattoo, coat and composition. Preserve the original asset, ID and Hon reviews; create a separate derivative with explicit cross-project lineage. The requested change is gun removal only; do not independently remove the holster, straps or other visible details.

CFA NOVA has received the exact source and direct user instruction through task messaging and is coordinating the production request. Please coordinate with CFA NOVA rather than dispatching a duplicate. Site Index has not generated an image or claimed Grok delivery. Return the actual request and intake status when available.
source: Direct Ziggy browser annotation in CFA SITE INDEX, thread 01a13383-26f6-7923-8e18-98faf1fa3ede, #hon/mission_control. Message records a user direction, not a completed edit.
